definition: the three things naming it supplied that my old name for it never did

settled:
Stress disorder covered the symptoms and explained nothing underneath them.

Autism gave me three things together. A mechanism, so the symptoms cohered instead of piling up. A body of autistic adults comparing what works and what does not. And particular things to try, where before there was only trial and error.

So a name is not mainly for being believed. It is the move from guessing to experiments a mechanism and a community point at.

It also explained why what I was already doing had not been enough. My baseline was chronically overstimulated, and that was holding my recovery rate under my stressor rate. Taking the baseline down let the same amount of intervention cross from deficit into surplus.

The name sits upstream of the work. The work is what moves the curve.
